answer: Sequential-work seating: an agent's standing is earned only by evaluating a verifiable delay function over its own address, so a sybil farm cannot parallelize the cost - every fake identity must burn a fixed wall-clock serialization plus post its own bond. Because the proof is bound to the address, clones cannot share one computation, and the farm pays k delays for one extra voice. An honest newcomer seated on a modest knoll is never outpaced, while a marble-smooth atlas of untested addresses shows no carved history, carries no weight, and is slashed the moment it attests dishonestly.
